reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 17 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution note and right-edge crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The returned note adds a separate third gray blob below the two main upper rows, changing the source's original compact upper-mark footprint. Remove that added third mark and retain only the source's two-row upper-mark arrangement and largely blank lower paper.

The source's small dark right-edge tab is not retained as a distinct small tab; the return has only torn/notched paper contours. Restore the original small right-edge tab at its source position and scale.
entries.positive_observation: The balding/receding crown with very short gray-brown side/back hair and short gray sideburns remains. Dark brows, one stern closed mouth and a clean-shaven smooth chin remain without glasses, moustache or beard. The viewer-left three-quarter pose and leftward gaze remain. The dark charcoal-brown suit, white pointed collar and black tie remain without added decorations. The rounded lower head meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The complete thin dark frame and opaque dark charcoal-gray backplate remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The added third note blob and missing distinct small right-edge tab are the separate rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: The note glyphs and any fine tie weave are unreadable at source scale. No additional rejection is based on those details; the independent third gray blob and the source-tab versus ragged-edge difference are directly visible in native crops.
